text: My favourite dentist in Bangkok, Dental Hut off Rama 2 road. Good prices and speak English.They do implants.

I regularly go to the dentist here and have had my teeth fixed ten times. The male dentist is quick and efficient. My teeth are working well and I no longer have to worry about thin or worn teeth. There's no long waiting list here. The dentist is the only one who takes care of my teeth.
The doctor gave excellent and detailed advice. They even took photos and taught me how to brush my teeth properly. It was great!
The teeth scaling took exactly 15 minutes and cost 900 baht. I've never had teeth scaling done this quickly before.
The dentist is highly skilled; the wisdom tooth extraction was painless. The service was excellent. I highly recommend them.
The dentist gave good advice. I've probably been receiving dental treatment from this dentist for over ten years.
The doctor gave excellent advice, the clinic was clean, and the service was great.

We've been getting our dental work done here for over 10 years, including my husband. The dentist is very kind and gentle, and explains every step clearly. The assistants are also lovely, and the prices are very reasonable. When we think of dentists, we always think of this place. I highly recommend it!
I've been to many dentists, but this one is the most reliable. I've recommended it to many relatives. Thank you, doctor, and I wish you continued success.
The doctor was very nice. He explained every step, which greatly reduced my fear.
Dental Hut: I brought my mother here to get dentures. It was okay.
